name: adaptive-effort
description: Picks reasoning effort per turn from the prompt, and only drops it when the saving outweighs the prompt-cache rewrite.

trivialEffort.title: Trivial asks
trivialEffort.description: Level for short asks with no complexity or judgment cue

planningEffort.title: Planning
planningEffort.description: Level for plans, roadmaps, specs, architecture

reviewEffort.title: Review
reviewEffort.description: Level for review, audit, verify, critique

complexEffort.title: Complex or explicit
complexEffort.description: Level for several complexity cues, complex pasted code, or 'think hard'

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long after a request its cache is assumed alive; past it, switching is free
